resources.string: Turn the screen off in LatentJam while music plays, and the full player waits on the lock screen
Cover. Swipe sideways to change track, drag down to close.
When the screen turns off while music plays, the full player opens on the lock screen
For now this works only if LatentJam is open when the screen turns off. To make it work from any app, allow LatentJam to display over other apps (if a list opens, find LatentJam in it).
This phone does not let apps open over the lock screen, so this works only if LatentJam is open when the screen turns off.
On this phone, also allow LatentJam to show on the lock screen and to open pop-up windows in the background, in its app permissions.
To open from other apps, the lock-screen player needs your permission to display over other apps.
